description: Image Description: The image features an open refrigerator with a retro design. The fridge door is fully open, revealing its interior. Inside the fridge, there are several shelves, mostly empty, with the exception of a saucepan placed on one of the middle shelves. The door has built-in racks, also empty, with space for storing bottles or other items. The lighting inside the refrigerator is on, illuminating the interior. The surrounding area includes a wooden cabinet above the fridge and a partial view of the kitchen floor
